analysis.summary: Stage deployment branch pattern changed from regex to exact match, breaking versioned release branch triggers

bugs.title: Stage deployment regex replaced with exact match
bugs.description: The branch condition for 'Deploy Stage' group changed from regex matching `release/*` branches to exact match on literal `release`, breaking deployments from versioned release branches like `release/v1.0.0`
bugs.risk: Pipeline will not trigger for standard release branches (e.g., release/1.2.3), blocking all stage deployments
bugs.codeSnippet:
- group: ':package: Deploy Stage'
-    if: build.branch =~ /^release\\// || build.branch =~ /^hotfix\\//
+    if: build.branch == 'release' || build.branch =~ /^hotfix\\//
     steps:

notBugs.reason: The permission check for website-release team was removed from firewall deployment steps while kept in main deployment. Potentially intentional refactoring, but marked as speculative since security requirements are not explicitly defined in the diff context.

While inconsistent with staging/prod naming conventions, the typo is internally consistent between the block key definition and the FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY env var reference in the same file, so it will not cause runtime errors.

notBugs.topic: Boolean string value changes (yes/no to true/false)
notBugs.reason: Intentional change paired with updated conditional logic checking for 'true' instead of 'yes'. The values are consistent within the new implementation.
